equation_summary: Two stages: (1) strict-causal triangular value correction — with P = tril_softmax(q k^T / sqrt(D), strict=True) (rows over j < i only), u_t = v_t - beta_t * sum_{j<t} P_tj u_j, i.e. u = (I + diag(beta) strict_tril(P))^{-1} v by forward substitution; (2) ordinary causal softmax attention o = softmax(q k^T / sqrt(D), causal incl. diagonal) @ u. The correction is a data-dependent strict-past triangular solve on values, followed by U1.S on the corrected values.
state_shape: external KV cache for (k, corrected-u) or recomputed u; beta from external projection
normalization: softmax (strict for the correction stage, non-strict causal for the output stage)
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM E[QKV/beta] ; B[strict-causal triangular value correction] ; U1.S(corrected V) ; E[output] matches naive_deltaformer_attn: strict tril softmax probs, sequential u_t = v_t - beta_t * (P_t @ u_<t), then causal attention over u.
CONFIRM the blocker: strict-past correction and its gradients must be preserved (stage 1 is strict-causal while stage 2 includes the diagonal), and no ordinary attention-only claim is possible.
CORRECT: the strict softmax uses a clamped denominator (clamp_min 1e-20, line 37) so fully-masked row t=0 yields all-zero probs; this edge policy must be part of the descriptor, not assumed.
axis: typed causal triangular transform (strict-past value correction; family shared with arch-010 PaTH)
direction_justification: The mixer is U1.S over values corrected by a data-dependent strict-causal triangular solve — a closed typed transform that differs from ordinary external projections and recurs in the PaTH family, hence an axis.
open_questions: Whether the DeltaFormer correction (value-domain solve with softmax-defined coefficients) and the PaTH transform (operand-domain Householder/UT correction) admit one shared descriptor or remain two distinct axis descriptors; cache semantics for corrected u across decode steps need a proof.
evidence_citations: fla/ops/deltaformer/naive.py:13-39 — tril_softmax strict=True: probs on j < i, clamp_min(1e-20) denominator.
fla/ops/deltaformer/naive.py:97-109 — u_t = v_t - beta_t * sum_{j<t} P_tj u_j; then naive_causal_attention over u.
fla/ops/deltaformer/naive.py:42-55 — stage-2 attention: causal mask incl. diagonal, softmax, @u.
